The covers feature classic superhero artwork, bold title logos, and price boxes.

artifact_observations.location: Title of the top-left comic ('The Mighty Thor')
artifact_observations.reasoning: The main title logo is structurally nonsensical. While it mimics the shape of the word 'THOR', the letters are melted and illegible (resembling 'AIOIVR' or similar). This is a hallmark AI failure in rendering specific brand typography.
The text block below the main title is completely garbled pseudo-text. It lacks distinct character separation and semantic meaning, appearing as smeared lines rather than words.
The red dots on the white cloth show slight irregularities in shape and spacing, with minor bleeding into the white areas, suggesting generative noise rather than a crisp printed fabric pattern.
The sword held by the character blends slightly into the background and the character's arm anatomy is somewhat indistinct, lacking clear boundary definition between the limb and the weapon.
